player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} ni. Nanhte Memory Game galaw ga ai.
Nanhte a lam hte maren, nanhte a opponent hpe n-ga shalun ya ai hte board hta card pawng shawng shalun ya ai ga ai.
Nanhte a turn hta, card 2 shalun ya ai hte pawng shawng shalun ya ai ga, '[0 1 1 0]' galaw ga ai, hte first card hta row 0 hte column 1, hte second card hta row 1 hte column 0 ni.
Card 2 shalun ya ai zawn, nanhte a point 1 hpe yu ai hte card 2 hpe face up hta galaw ga ai. Shalun ya ai n-ga, card 2 hpe face down hta galaw ga ai, e.g. '.'.
Game hta pair shawng shalun ya ai zawn, game galaw ga ai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: N jaw ai shamu shamawt hkrang. {player_id} ginsup wa gaw, kadun lapran kaw na hkrak re ai shara hte mahtai n lu shapraw shi ai.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: N jaw ai shamu shamawt. ginsup ninghkring {player_id} gaw shinggan de na shara hpe lata la sai.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: N jaw ai shamu shamawt lam. {player_id} ginsup wa gaw dai sha ka matsing hpe lahkawng lang lata la sai.
invalid_move.already_matched: N jaw ai shamu shamawt lam. ginsup masha {player_id} gaw, kalang mi (sh) lahkawng lang hta n-ga matsing da sai sumpu hpe lata la lu na re.

game_message.cards_match: Player {player_id} a card 2 shalun ya ai hte position [{r1} {c1}] hte [{r2} {c2}] shalun ya ai!
game_message.cards_no_match: Player {player_id} a card 2 shalun ya ai n-ga ai. Card hta position [{r1} {c1}] hte [{r2} {c2}] hte {pos1} hte {pos2} shalun ya ai.

outcome.draw: Hpung lahkawng yan gaw, lawu na zawn ka ni hpe maren sha lu lang ai.
outcome.win: Hkawn ai wa gaw {winner_id} awng dang sai!
outcome.turn_limit: Tung hpang ai hkrat sum machyi hkra. Hpang shani gaw shakut. Hpang shani mi 0 gaw {score_0} mang byin, Hpang shani mi 1 gaw {score_1} mang byin.
outcome.turn_limit_win: {reason} Player {winner_id} ŋa woi hkrang na chyu ga!
